leather.author: Rob Tuytel
leather.usage: Original green seat colour retained; OpenGL normal and roughness data are packed into one 512px desktop / 256px coarse runtime texture. No external runtime requests.

otherSurfaces: Existing project /surfaces wood, plaster and paving maps; sources are linked in README.md (Poly Haven Brown Planks 03, Damaged Plaster and Cobblestone Floor 08). Original station/train atlases and window reflection map are documented in SOURCE.json.
